claims.text: A model gateway should route work by capability, risk, latency, cost, and modality rather than hard-code one provider into every task.
claims.visualEncoding: Top gateway spanning six equally weighted provider chambers

claims.text: A production agent control plane declares roles, instructions, routing, handoffs, budgets, permissions, and stop conditions.
Context and memory should be scoped, retrieved, and persisted deliberately rather than treated as an unlimited prompt.
Tools and connectors should use typed contracts, least privilege, provenance, and result validation.
Long-running production work needs explicit state, retries, checkpoints, idempotency, and compensation paths.
claims.visualEncoding: Lower runtime engine with recovery loop

claims.text: High-impact actions require policy gates, scoped permissions, human approval, and a durable audit trail.
Traces, evaluations, cost, latency, and incident evidence must be first-class runtime outputs.
MCP connects an AI system to tools and context; A2A coordinates work between independent agents.
